name: Rukhan Redspur
source_profile: ● Rukhan Redspur (CN) is a young and charismatic mounted warrior who has gained a following among Varkesh clans displaced by Cadorian ranches. He advocates driving settlers from the grasslands and has already led several cattle raids.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 49 (source excerpt; may be partial)
